source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
This one was exceptionally difficult.

- I detected and removed 19 different hacking backdoors, which suggests that several parties probably hacked the site.
- All of the malware spam posts arrived in May, while the earliest attack files were uploaded in April.
- Given how severe the infection is, restoring an earlier backup is the best approach. However, the earliest version available on WP-Engine was created on June 24th, and it is infected too.
- The removal was completed, but there were some problems with the page and post status.

I'm going to make another fresh attempt.

execution.observed_behavior: Malware-generated spam posts had been injected into Oakbridge in May.

routing_warnings.description: The reported blank pages and trashed legitimate pages concern restoration of legitimate site content rather than deletion of injected spam.
The backup restoration and return to a normal appearance concern page and layout restoration.
Submission of malicious links for removal concerns external search-index cleanup rather than deletion of spam content from Oakbridge.
WP Engine's clean malware scan verifies executable malware eradication but does not specifically verify deletion of injected spam posts.
